paper.title: On Learning to Rank Long Sequences with Contextual Bandits

settings.name_in_paper: Contextual cascading bandits with flexible-length sequences, rewards and losses (independent outcomes)
unmapped: Item success probabilities follow a logistic GLM p(x)=sigma(u^T x) with independent outcomes across items
Sequence length is chosen by the learner (up to a per-round budget b_t <= b); position-dependent decreasing rewards r_{j,t} in [0,1] and losses l_{j,t} in [-1,0] revealed per round
The learner knows the bound D on |u^T x|, the maximal budget b, and the link-function constants c_sigma, c_sigma'
settings.definition_quote: At each time $t$, the learner processes a transaction having at its disposal a (finite) set of actions $A_t =\{x_{1,t}, \ldots, x_{k_t,t}\} \subseteq A = \{x \in \R^d\,:\, ||x||_2 \leq 1\}$ ... In round $t$, the algorithm is compelled to play an ordered sequence of actions $J_t$ ... The budget constraint $b_t$ requires $s_t \leq b_t$.

settings.name_in_paper: Contextual cascading bandits with dependent outcomes (coverage-difference GLM model)
unmapped: Conditional success probabilities given previous failures follow a logistic GLM on submodular coverage-difference vectors
settings.definition_quote: p(x_j \mid x_{i_1}, \ldots, x_{i_k}) = \sigma({\bar c}(x_j \mid x_{i_1}, \ldots, x_{i_k})^\top u)

algorithms.name: Contextual bandit algorithm for the independent case (Algorithm 1, 'Ind')
Bandit Greedy for the dependent case (Algorithm 2, 'Dep')

symbols.z: upper bound on the derivative of the link function sigma (z=1 for logistic)
symbols.c_sigma: constant with 1-c_sigma <= sigma(Delta) <= c_sigma on [-D_w,D_w] (e^D/(1+e^D) for logistic)
symbols.D_w: bound on |u^T x| over all actions (paper's D)
symbols.alpha_bdT: log factor alpha(b,d,T,delta) = O(b D^2 + (c_sigma/c_sigma')^2 d log(1+(T c_sigma/(1-c_sigma)+log(T/delta))/b) + ((c_sigma/c_sigma')^2+(1+D)/c_sigma') log(bT/delta) + D^2 log(bdT/delta))

conditions: u^T x in [-D_w, D_w] for all x in A
rewards r_{i,t} in [0,1] non-increasing, losses l_{i,t} in [-1,0] non-increasing
tuning: width parameter D = D_w, maximal budget b, confidence delta as inputs

source.label: t:independent
source.quote: Then with probability at least $1-\delta$, with $\delta < 1/e$, the cumulative regret of Algorithm \ref{f:2} run with a link function $\sigma$ such that $\sigma'(\Delta) \leq z$ for all $\Delta \in \R$ satisfies \sum_{t=1}^T \E_{Y_t} [R(J^*_t,Y_t)] - \E_{Y_t} [R(J_t,Y_t)]\leq 4z\sqrt{\frac{e\,c_{\sigma}}{1-c_{\sigma}}T \alpha(b,d,T,\delta) }\,d\log(1+T)

results.notes: Regret is through expected rewards given the chosen sequence against Bayes-optimal per-round sequence; bound holds w.p. 1-delta so recorded as high_probability_regret. Overall O~(sqrt(bT)) dependence on b. Remark 1: for logistic link c_sigma/(1-c_sigma)=e^D, z=1. alpha kept as declared symbol.
